## Changes

### New
- Infinite scroll in the reader: the next chapter follows the last page and the previous one comes in when you scroll up past the first page, so you can keep reading without a stop. Turn it on in Reader settings (vertical reading only).
- Open the chapter you're reading in WebView, from the reader's menu. Reader settings moved into the same menu.
- Smoother scrolling on phones with a high refresh rate screen.
- The extension list shows which repo each extension comes from.
- A switch for the kuru-kuru sound, under Theme in More.

### Changes
- The button at the end of a chapter now takes you back to the comic instead of Home.
- Hide 18+ is on only in the Available tab, so your installed extensions always show.

### Fixes
- Some Mihon extensions, like MangaDex, failed to open comics with "lateinit property title has not been initialized".
